title: Vaporesso XROS 5 Mini Pod Kit

Vaporesso XROS 5 Mini Pod Kit
is a draw-activated refillable pod system with a 1500mAh battery, COREX 3.0 heating technology, and adjustable airflow in a slim, buttonless design.

Battery:

Charging:

description_html:
The Vaporesso XROS 5 Mini Pod Kit is a draw-activated refillable pod system with a 1500mAh battery, COREX 3.0 heating technology, and adjustable airflow in a slim, buttonless design.

  • Product Type: Open Pod System (Refillable)
  • Battery: 1500mAh
  • Wattage: Up to 30W (Auto-Adjusts to Coil)
  • Charging: USB Type-C (2A Fast Charge)
  • E-Liquid Capacity: 3mL
  • Coil Type: Integrated COREX 3.0 Mesh
  • Coil Resistance: 0.6Ω (included)
  • Activation: Draw-Activated (No Buttons)
  • Airflow: Adjustable Slider (MTL to RDL)
  • Display: LED Tidal Light Strip (Battery Indicator)
  • Fill Method: Top Fill
  • Pod Compatibility: All Vaporesso XROS Pods (0.4Ω, 0.6Ω, 0.8Ω, 1.0Ω, 1.2Ω - COREX 3.0 and 2.0)
  • Brand: Vaporesso

E-liquid sold separately. Fill with your choice of salt nic or freebase e-liquid.

Available options: Black, Titanium Silver.
